_meta.label: Awareness Stage
_meta.instruction: The audience's awareness stage is the variable under test. Talk at the selected stage. Do not assume they already want the product unless the stage is product-aware or most-aware.

problem_aware.label: Problem Aware
problem_aware.definition: The audience knows the problem but may not know this solution. Talk more about the problem and make the next step feel smaller.

solution_aware.label: Solution Aware
solution_aware.definition: The audience knows solutions exist and has likely tried some. Explain why this type of solution is different.

product_aware.label: Product Aware
product_aware.definition: The audience knows the product. Focus on differentiation, proof, and objection handling. Do not re-introduce the whole product.

most_aware.label: Most Aware
most_aware.definition: The audience understands the product and wants a reason to act. Use offer, reminder, or direct CTA only when those facts are supplied.
